# IOpenLobbies.Search method

Asks Steam for the open lobbies, once per search distance from near to worldwide, which takes a few seconds. A search already running is not started again.

```csharp
public bool Search()
```

## Return Value

False when no search can run: while the player is in an online lobby or match, where the game runs its own search, or joining a lobby.
